narr: Deep monsoon moisture over northern Arizona with light steering winds brought locally heavy rain to parts of the area.
ev: The USGS stream gauge on the Verde Rive downstream of Camp Verde (VCVA3) recorded a 1.68 foot rise from 500 PM to 700 PM. The river returned to normal around 200 AM on the 18th. The heavy rain likely fell over the West Clear Creek drainage.
A USGS stream gage on the Verde river showed a one foot rise upstream from Camp Verde.
The USGS stream gauge on the Agua Fira River near Dewey-Humboldt (AFHA3) reported a 2.75 foot rise bettween 700 PM and 745 PM. The river returnred to near normal at 200 AM on the 18th.
lsr: Post event report from Wednesday afternoon. A USGS stream gage upstream of Camp Verde (VAVA3) reported a 1 foot rise.
Post event report from Wednesday evening. A USGS stream gage downstream of Camp Verde (VCVA3) recorded a 1.68 foot rise.
USGS stream gauge along the Agua Fira River near Dewey-Humboldt (AFHA3) reported a 2.75 foot rise from nearby thunderstorms.
